verdicts.reason: Both follow the same left-to-right layout. In both, the 'Shop the Summer Line' CTA wraps awkwardly onto two lines and is cramped against the right edge, and in both the headline dominates. A keeps the sun logo with the SOLSTICE wordmark, although the wordmark is microscopic and barely readable. In B the logo shrinks to an almost invisible dot with no readable wordmark, so the brand is effectively lost and the left side reads as dead space.
